name: 承認対象と親作業の見出し
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Render ONE static Japanese Lighthouse approval heading block LH09-0035. Originals images1–2 control layout, hierarchy, proportions, baseline spacing, chevron silhouette and optical stroke. Japanese mock3 supplies exact wording but is secondary for typography/fine details.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas. Compact block about666x106 logical pixels, source-like left inset22px, top10px. Three left-aligned text roles:
Top project metadata「礼拝の準備」in Meiryo Regular12/16, muted neutral #667078.
Second line parent task breadcrumb「資料を準備する」in Meiryo Regular14/24, same neutral, followed closely by ONE original slim right-facing CHEVRON. Preserve original chevron small optical size, line stroke and baseline, not a filled triangle or text greater-than character.
Third line main heading「資料の確認」in Meiryo Bold20/28, near-black. Clear hierarchy: only this main heading bold. Main heading sits about18px below breadcrumb baseline as original. Preserve compact source line spacing and lots of clear room to right without inventing content.
No cards, tinted panels, borders, shadows, colored icons, additional breadcrumbs, buttons, badges, underline, logos, app shell, watermark, perspective, annotations or comparison grid. Preserve exact Japanese wording, no all-bold output, zero tracking. Flat crisp UI screenshot, tight composition with minimal outside whitespace.
reviewNotes: 3段の日本語と見出し階層を目視確認。パンくずのシェブロンが原本より太く大きいため訂正。タイトルの極太感と外側余白にも注意。エージェント画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
